items.briefing:
Australia's corporate regulator ASIC has warned that scammers are increasingly using AI to build convincing deepfake investment scam networks, meaning fake videos or profiles may look highly realistic — Australians should be extra cautious about any unsolicited investment opportunities online. Separately, a China-linked hacker group has demonstrated advanced AI capabilities in attacks targeting the Asia-Pacific region, which includes Australia, suggesting cyber threats in our region are becoming more sophisticated.

OpenAI has launched a teen-specific version of ChatGPT in Australia with additional safety features — if your organisation has young learners using AI tools, now is a good time to review which platforms they're accessing. **Practical tip:** If you receive an investment offer online — even from someone who appears on video — verify their identity through official channels before engaging.

featured.title: ReliaQuest deepens Anthropic deal to bolster GreyMatter
featured.summary: GreyMatter users will gain wider access to Anthropic's Claude models as ReliaQuest brings them deeper into its threat response platform.
